Filter assays where chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1217643'. Join activities on assay_id. Join molecule_dictionary on molregno to get molecule_chembl_id. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to get canonical_smiles. Keep only rows where standard_relation = '=' and standard_value is not null and standard_relation is not null. Return canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
